0.en: Today, HE dares to break the engagement first.
0.th: วันนี้เขากล้าบอกยกเลิกหมั้นเอง
0.vi: Hôm nay, ANH ta dám chủ động huỷ hôn.
0.id: Hari ini, DIA berani membatalkan tunangan duluan.
0.ms: Hari ni, DIA berani batalkan pertunangan dulu.
0.fil: Ngayon, SIYA pa ang unang nagpakansel ng engagement.

2.en: You're standing on my blood pit.
2.th: เธอย่ำอยู่บนบ่อเลือดของฉัน
2.vi: Cậu đang đứng trên hố máu của tôi.
2.fil: Nakatapak ka sa butas ng dugo ko.

5.en: Today I'm here to end this engagement.
5.th: วันนี้ฉันมาเพื่อยกเลิกการหมั้นนี้
5.vi: Hôm nay tôi đến để huỷ hôn ước này.
5.id: Hari ini aku datang untuk membatalkan tunangan ini.
5.ms: Hari ni saya datang nak batalkan pertunangan ini.
5.fil: Dumating ako ngayon para tapusin ang engagement na 'to.

6.en: My Yun family chose you as a scholar,
6.th: ตระกูลหยุนของฉันเลือกเธอเพราะเห็นว่าเป็นนักปราชญ์
6.vi: Nhà họ Yun chọn cậu vì cậu là thư sinh,
6.id: Keluarga Yun memilihmu karena kau seorang sarjana,
6.ms: Keluarga Yun pilih awak sebab awak orang berilmu,
6.fil: Pinili ka ng pamilyang Yun kasi iskolar ka,

7.th: และยอมรับคู่หมั้นนี้อย่างไม่เต็มใจ
7.vi: và ngại ngùng nhận hôn ước này.
7.fil: at napilitang tanggapin ang match na 'to.

8.th: แล้วตอนนี้ล่ะ?

9.en: You're so poor you boil stones to eat,
9.th: จนจนจะต้นหินกินแล้ว
9.vi: Nghèo đến mức luộc đá để ăn,
9.id: Miskin sampai merebus batu untuk makan,
9.ms: Miskin sampai rebus batu nak makan,
9.fil: Ang hirap mo na, bato ang niluluto mong kainin,

10.en: yet you're digging your own grave here.
10.th: ยังมาขุดหลุมฝังตัวเองตรงนี้
10.vi: mà còn tự đào hố chôn mình ở đây.
10.id: tapi menggali kuburan sendiri di sini.
10.ms: tapi gali kubur sendiri kat sini.
10.fil: tapos sarili mong libingan pa ang hukayin mo rito.

11.th: ถ้าให้คนรู้

12.en: you'd shame my Yun family completely.
12.th: ใบหน้าตระกูลหยุนของฉันจะสู้ยิบตา
12.vi: mặt nhà họ Yun mất hết cả.
12.id: muka keluarga Yun hancur karena kamu.
12.ms: maruah keluarga Yun hancur sebab awak.

14.en: A toad dreaming of swan meat.
14.th: คางคกฝันกินเนื้อหงส์
14.vi: Cóc mà mơ ăn thịt thiên nga.
14.fil: Palaka, nangangarap ng karne ng swan.

15.th: คนจนตกต่ำแบบเธอ
15.vi: Một kẻ nghèo kiếp như cậu

16.en: doesn't deserve a treasure like Yun Shu.
16.th: ไม่มีทางคู่ควรกับสาวงามอย่างหยุนชู
16.vi: đâu xứng với bảo ngọc như Vân Thư.
16.id: tak layak untuk harta berharga seperti Yun Shu.
16.ms: tak layak untuk permata seperti Yun Shu.
16.fil: hindi karapat-dapat sa mentol na katulad ni Yun Shu.

18.en: why waste anger on this trash?
18.th: ทำไมต้องโมโหกับขยะแบบนี้
18.vi: Phải giận gì con rác này.
18.ms: Kenapa marah pada sampah macam ni?
18.fil: Bakit ka pa magagalit sa basurang 'to?

19.th: มันจะทำมือคุณเปื้อน
19.vi: Chỉ làm bẩn tay chú thôi.

20.th: ในหนาวแบบนี้

21.en: only my mansion in the city
21.th: เฉพาะคฤหาสน์ของข้าในเมือง
21.vi: chỉ có phủ của ta trong thành
21.fil: ang mansion ko lang sa siyudad

22.th: จะให้ความอบอุ่นที่แท้จริงแก่เธอได้
22.vi: mới cho em sự ấm áp thật sự.
22.fil: ang makapagbibigay sa'yo ng tunay na init.

23.th: ห้องใต้ดินของตระกูลเหอข้า
23.vi: Hầm của nhà họ Ho ta

24.en: is stocked with coal enough to burn all winter.
24.th: สต็อกถ่านไว้เผาได้ทั้งฤดูหนาว
24.vi: chứa than đủ đốt cả mùa đông.
24.id: dipenuhi batu bara untuk sepanjang musim dingin.
24.ms: penuh dengan arang untuk sepanjang musim sejuk.
24.fil: punong-puno ng uling para sa buong taglamig.

25.th: ย้ายเข้าไปสิ

26.en: and even if the sky falls,
26.th: แม้ฟ้าจะถล่ม

27.en: not one of your fingers will freeze.
27.th: นิ้วของเธอก็จะไม่เย็นเป็นน้ำแข็งแม้แต่นิ้วเดียว
27.vi: một ngón tay em cũng chẳng cóng.
27.id: satu jarimu pun tak akan beku.
27.ms: satu jaripun awak tak akan beku.
27.fil: hindi mangangalay ang kahit isang daliri mo.

28.th: โยนสมุดทะเบียนสมรสมานี่
28.vi: Ném giấy kết hôn qua đây.
28.fil: Iharap mo na ang marriage paper.

29.en: Then you can all get lost.
29.th: แล้วพวกคุณจะได้หายไปจากที่นี่
29.vi: Rồi các người biến khỏi đây.
29.id: Lalu kalian bisa pergi dari sini.
29.fil: Tapos pwede na kayong umalis lahat.

30.th: เธอพูดว่าอะไรนะ

32.th: โยนสมุดทะเบียนสมรสมานี่
32.vi: ném giấy kết hôn qua đây.
32.fil: iharap mo na ang marriage paper.
